item.title: Go-ahead secured for revamp of Liverpool’s Coopers Building
item.description: Hot on the heels of a management agreement being signed this month with Spanish hotelier Libere Hospitality Group, upper floors of the Church Street building can now be converted to a 148-bed aparthotel. The post Go-ahead secured for revamp of Liverpool’s Coopers Building appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: VIDEO | Can Greater Manchester close its North/South divide?
item.description: Growth across the 10 boroughs that make up GM is outpacing the national average but leaders in places like Bolton, Oldham, and Rochdale are still fighting hard to overcome intracity region disparities. Participants at a roundtable discussion hosted by Euan Kellie Property Solutions explored how best to close the gap. The post VIDEO | Can Greater Manchester close its North/South divide? appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Muller plans 411 homes on Cheshire East countryside
item.description: Leveraging a lack of five-year housing supply, the developer has put in for permission to build up a neighbourhood and accompanying spine road on 49 acres south of Nantwich. The post Muller plans 411 homes on Cheshire East countryside appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: M&S lines up Colne foodhall
item.description: The retailer wants to build a 24,748 sq ft store adjacent to forecourt operator EG on the Move’s Colne services, where Whitewalls Drive meets the M65. The post M&S lines up Colne foodhall appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Fylde triggers pair of St Annes projects
item.description: Phase two of a masterplan for the town centre, comprising the Pier Link and Garden Street schemes, has been put into motion this week with contractor George Cox & Sons now on site. The post Fylde triggers pair of St Annes projects appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Cumberland committee refuses care home
item.description: A 72-bed facility on a former hospital site has been rejected, while committee approved a visitor centre and other works for the Iron Line coastal path, along with Carlisle housing. The post Cumberland committee refuses care home appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: L&G tables industrial overhaul with potential for 280,000 sq ft data centre
item.description: A 175,000 sq ft industrial unit is the other option being considered for an eight-acre site in Trafford Park currently occupied by GXO and owned by the BMW pension fund. The post L&G tables industrial overhaul with potential for 280,000 sq ft data centre appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Cheshire East looks to fend off eco-lodges, but land promoters pile in
item.description: A further 195 homes are recommended for approval at the council’s next strategic planning board, although proposals to expand a pub and hotel’s offering in Mere face rejection. The post Cheshire East looks to fend off eco-lodges, but land promoters pile in appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: GALLERY | Future is Female
item.description: It was a full house on Wednesday night as property professionals gathered to discuss the importance of having diverse voices in placemaking. Held in association with Close Brothers Property Finance and Velux, the event featured an inspiring discussion that celebrated how far the industry has come in terms of representation, while also pushing for more work to be done. The post GALLERY | Future is Female appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Seaford Finance launches SME division
item.description: David Thomas will lead the Manchester-based broker’s new service line, which will provide loans of between £1m and £5m and is targeting up to £150m of debt origination in year one. The post Seaford Finance launches SME division appeared first on Place North West.
